config.note: Series keys are country|real and country|nominal. The BIS 'selected' series: one representative national index per country (all dwellings, whole country, existing and new where available), so the object differs a little across countries; the real index is the nominal one divided by CPI, which is what makes cross-country comparison honest. Index levels say nothing about affordability: use them for growth and for peaks. The Turkish nominal index is in the thousands because it starts in 2010 at 100 and the lira has inflated since; read TR|real. Coverage begins in the 1970s for the US, UK, Japan and Australia, 2005 to 2010 for Türkiye, China and Poland
